findings.text: The localization is demonstrated on a reconstructed banked terminal compensator step rule, not on a live production Krylov pass. H200 job 1280166 predates the active_set_* history arrays and retained only the final frozen-mask pass, so the first failing active-set pass cannot be numbered and the required every-pass table remains unproduced. Commit 808b2551f now makes all five limitations machine-readable and the worker correctly assigns the fresh receipt to the repair follow-on.

Both reviewed commits are local-only at review time: edf04ca11 and provenance repair 808b2551f are reachable from the reviewed worktree head but neither is an ancestor of review base 78255cd6. Coordinator integration must land both before or with the cap-factor repair; otherwise the repair would depend on instrumentation absent from the primary branch.

gate_arms_note: The reviewed manifest explicitly records baseline_suite and after_suite as not armed because the node changed no test file. There are no readable suite-arm logs from which a failure delta can be computed; added_failure_count 0 and added_failure_ids [] therefore record no observed added suite failures, not a claim that a baseline/after suite ran. The node's custom diagnostic gate exited 0 and was independently rerun at the reviewed head.

justifications.durability: Both commits have conventional subjects and substantive bodies, contain no attribution trailer or plan/ticket label, and the reviewed worktree has no tracked changes at head 808b2551f. The second commit materially improves durability by recording the reconstructed/live distinction and unavailable history in the JSON receipt, pinned by a successful head assertion and a failing parent-revision negative arm. The remaining deduction is reachability: neither edf04ca11 nor 808b2551f is an ancestor of review base 78255cd6, so the code is still a detached worker deliverable rather than primary-branch state, and the report remains outside the repository.
justifications.evidence: The load-bearing claim could fail and did reproduce first-hand. The persisted state is finite float64 shape (772,), and hashing its binary64 bytes gives f1097ebdb78a38860580e589c878105a1ba7832ac87bcf63f6ce30a51efdbfbd, matching the receipt. The current cap form gives [1,-1,NaN], while an independent evaluation of step_limit/maximum(step_limit,abs(raw)) gives [1,-1,0.1], all finite and equal to its central difference. The target's earlier complete bordered-map attempt also shows a finite flux-map JVP before the separate step-rule probe exposes the level tangent, supporting the localization. Source inspection confirms NONFINITE_LINEAR_ACTION is selected from the pre-Arnoldi probe_action finite check, so slot 0 is the correct Krylov location. The worker does not overstate the missing pass ordinal after its provenance repair.
justifications.fit: The diagnostic is appropriately isolated in the benchmark driver and calls the production BoundedExteriorFieldUnknown.damped_step for the observed path. Its receipt is compact, machine-readable, source-revision and source-job aware, and now distinguishes reconstructed evidence from a live Krylov pass. The proposed repair preserves the cap below and above its threshold without changing bounds, tolerances, or solver defaults. The report clearly separates the confirmed local derivative defect from the unproduced H200 every-pass result. Small deductions remain because the report's outcome language says the first non-finite operand is localized without leading with the reconstructed-state qualifier, and its per-pass table necessarily has only an ordinal-unavailable final row rather than the requested full history.

The external report is within its granted path. No solver source, tolerance, default, test, figure, plan, or evidence fragment changed.
